description: Source code for a Generic Netlink Controller library, including functions for managing netlink families, groups, and cache, with parsing and resolution functionalities.

methods.name: ctrl_request_update
methods.description: Sends a request to update the family cache via genl_send_simple.

methods.name: genl_ctrl_alloc_cache
methods.description: Allocates and fills a cache of generic netlink families.

methods.name: genl_ctrl_search
methods.description: Searches for a family by ID in the cache.

methods.name: genl_ctrl_search_by_name
methods.description: Searches for a family by name in the cache.

methods.name: genl_ctrl_resolve
methods.description: Resolves a family name to its ID.

methods.name: genl_ctrl_grp_by_name
methods.description: Finds a multicast group ID by name within a family.

methods.name: genl_ctrl_resolve_grp
methods.description: Resolves a group name within a family to its ID.
